# Header fixtures

`header_v1.hex` is the independent canonical-row vector used by the format unit tests.

`prague_header.json` is the public Prague test header and expected hash from Alloy's
`serde_rlp_prague` test, distributed under MIT OR Apache-2.0:
https://github.com/alloy-rs/alloy/blob/df0a0b52a5a84f6a80d1cf82e44d3d51088259a1/crates/consensus/src/block/header.rs

It is a test-network header, not a mainnet checkpoint. No RPC requests are used by these tests.
The hash is copied from the upstream vector, not generated by this implementation.
